paragraphs: He reported a teaching of Shmuel through Rav Chiyya bar Ashi. See [Pesachim 30b](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.30b.10).[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Pesachim gives the chain in full: Rava bar Abba reports Rav Chiyya bar Ashi, who reports Shmuel.

[Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3101&lang=en) records the same chain. Hyman’s notice gives Rava bar Abba in its heading and abbreviates the reporting formula in the body.
